Copy page Authentication Details Composio-managed OAuth available OAuth2 Frequently Asked Questions How do I set up custom OAuth credentials for Asana? Use your own Asana app when you want users to see your app's name on the consent screen and control the credentials yourself. Create the Asana app Sign in to Asana and open the Asana developer console . Click + New App and enter an app name, such as Composio Integration . The app website is optional. In the app's OAuth settings, add the redirect URL https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add . It must exactly match the oauth_redirect_uri field in your Composio auth config. Save the app and copy the Client ID and Client Secret . Create the auth config in Composio In the Composio dashboard, go to Auth Configs , click Create Auth Config , and select Asana . Set the authentication type to OAuth2 and choose Use your own developer authentication . Paste the Client ID and Client Secret , add any scopes you need, then click Create Asana Auth Config . Click Connect Account , sign in to Asana, and approve access to your workspace. Confirm the account shows as Active . See Custom auth configs for the general flow. Scopes The default auth config doesn't request specific scopes. To request granular scopes such as tasks:read , projects:read , or workspaces:read , enable them in the Asana app's OAuth settings and add the same values to the auth config's Scopes field. Request only what your integration uses.
